meta.title: Lead: Specific USAID/NED/GMF/Dexis funding to Polish NGOs and Iustitia support for TK judges
meta.notes: Documented grant amounts and intermediaries for rule-of-law, election integrity, and civic education projects; one-time financial support request by Iustitia for Markiewicz and Taborowski. Facts only, no conclusions.

nodes.label: German Marshall Fund CEBRICS (Central Europe – Building Resilience in Civil Society)
Dexis CEP ROLA (USAID Central Europe Program Rule of Law Activity)
Fundacja Dom Sędziego Seniora (incl. Fundusz Pomocy)

edges.relation: primary funder of CEBRICS; 2023 total $1,286,587 across 44 projects in BG/HU/PL

4 grants totaling $79,910 focused on electoral integrity and mobilization for Oct 2023 parliamentary election; partners included HFHR; outcomes included Electoral Lighthouse app (5.6M users) and Election Superhero campaign (125k users)
implementer of Central Europe Program Rule of Law Activity; cooperative agreement 7200AA22CA00025 ~$6.4M (Building Resilience in Civil Society, Poland focus); civic education grants $5k–25k USD
grants including $45,000 USD (Improving Access to Information) and $40,000 USD (Freedom of Information – Recovery Action)
USAID-funded project 'Watchdogs - expansion, effectiveness, sustainability and resilience' ~235,385 PLN

multiple grants documented in HFHR reports (e.g. Strengthening Civil Society Resilience, Promoting Civic Engagement, Dokumentowanie zbrodni wojennych na Ukrainie ~369k PLN, Strengthening and Protecting Civil Society in Eurasia ~2.28M PLN); Proelio aggregates 11.5 mln zł via NED for 2021-2023 based on foundation reports
named partner in CEBRICS; received funding within the $1.28M 2023 portfolio
co-founder (with Themis and others); applied Oct 2026 for one-time 75,000 PLN support each to Krystian Markiewicz and Maciej Taborowski from Fundusz Pomocy (citizen donations for repressed judges)
